storeInfo.name: Bianca
storeInfo.tagline: Modern Italian & Mediterranean Fare in Greenwich | Cocina Italiana y Mediterránea

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en la calle o en el lote municipal cercano.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Street parking and nearby municipal parking lots available.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Finos cortes de lomo de res con alcaparras, arúgula fresca, aceite de oliva virgen extra y queso parmesano rallado.
products.descriptionEn: Thinly sliced tenderloin with capers, fresh arugula, extra virgin olive oil, and shaved parmesan cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Burrata fresca horneada sobre salsa de tomate pomodoro casera, albahaca y pan rústico tostado al ajillo.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh baked burrata over homemade pomodoro sauce, basil, and garlic toasted rustic bread.

products.descriptionEs: Pulpo tierno marinado en hierbas mediterráneas, servido con puré de papa al limón y aceite de pimentón ahumado.
products.descriptionEn: Tender octopus marinated in Mediterranean herbs, served with lemon potato mash and smoked paprika oil.

products.descriptionEs: Pasta rigatoni al dente en una rica salsa cremosa de tomate, vodka, peperoncino y queso pecorino romano.
products.descriptionEn: Al dente rigatoni pasta tossed in a rich, creamy tomato vodka sauce with a touch of chili and pecorino romano.

products.descriptionEs: Abundantes camarones, mejillones, almejas y calamares salteados con vino blanco, ajo y tomates cherry frescos.
products.descriptionEn: Abundant shrimp, mussels, clams, and calamari sautéed with white garlic wine sauce and fresh cherry tomatoes.

products.descriptionEs: Pechuga de pollo empanizada crujiente, horneada con salsa marinera, queso mozzarella fundido y albahaca, servida con espagueti.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy breaded chicken breast baked with marinara sauce, melted mozzarella cheese, and basil, served with spaghetti.

products.descriptionEs: Corte prime de res a la parrilla de 8oz, bañado en una reducción de vino tinto Chianti, acompañado de risotto de hongos porcini.
products.descriptionEn: 8oz prime grilled filet mignon draped in a rich Chianti red wine reduction, served with porcini mushroom risotto.

products.descriptionEs: Pescado branzino asado a la parrilla con hierbas provenzales, limón y aceite de oliva virgen, servido con espárragos salteados.
products.descriptionEn: Grilled whole Mediterranean branzino infused with herbs, lemon, and extra virgin olive oil, served with roasted asparagus.

products.descriptionEs: Arroz arborio cremoso cocinado con infusión de azafrán, trozos tiernos de langosta de Maine y un toque de mantequilla de trufa.
products.descriptionEn: Creamy arborio rice simmered with saffron infusion, tender chunks of Maine lobster, and a touch of truffle butter.

products.descriptionEs: Limonada artesanal fresca con infusión de jarabe natural de lavanda y un toque de agua con gas.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh craft lemonade infused with natural lavender syrup and a splash of sparkling water.

products.descriptionEs: Vodka premium, licor de café Kahlúa, espresso recién extraído y un toque de crema de cacao.
products.descriptionEn: Premium vodka, Kahlúa coffee liqueur, freshly pulled espresso, and a hint of crème de cacao.

products.descriptionEs: Delicados bizcochos empapados en espresso, crema de mascarpone ligera y cacao amargo en polvo.
products.descriptionEn: Delicate ladyfingers soaked in espresso, rich whipped mascarpone cream, and bitter cocoa powder.

products.descriptionEs: Bolas de arroz Arborio crujientes rellenas de mozzarella ahumada y pasta de trufa negra, servidas con salsa marinara casera.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy Arborio rice balls stuffed with smoked mozzarella and black truffle paste, served with house-made marinara sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Finas rodajas de calabacín amarillo y verde, alcaparras, queso parmesano añejo, piñones tostados y emulsión de limón Meyer.
products.descriptionEn: Thin slices of yellow and green zucchini, capers, aged parmesan cheese, toasted pine nuts, and Meyer lemon emulsion.

products.descriptionEs: Pan rústico tostado con requesón artesanal, higos frescos de temporada, jamón prosciutto di Parma y un toque de miel de lavanda.
products.descriptionEn: Toasted rustic bread with artisanal ricotta, fresh seasonal figs, prosciutto di Parma, and a drizzle of lavender honey.

products.descriptionEs: Mejillones de la costa salteados con vino blanco Pinot Grigio, ajo confitado, tomates cherry y hierbas provenzales con pan tostado.
products.descriptionEn: Coastal mussels sautéed with Pinot Grigio white wine, confit garlic, cherry tomatoes, and herbes de Provence with toasted bread.

products.descriptionEs: Tomates heirloom jugosos, pepino persa, aceitunas Kalamata, cebolla roja, crutones de focaccia y queso feta de cabra.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy heirloom tomatoes, Persian cucumber, Kalamata olives, red onion, focaccia croutons, and goat feta cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Pasta ancha fresca hecha en casa con un estofado lento de jabalí silvestre, vino tinto Chianti y pecorino romano rallado.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh house-made wide ribbon pasta with slow-braised wild boar stew, Chianti red wine, and grated Pecorino Romano.
Grilled organic chicken breast with aged Marsala wine reduction, sautéed wild mushrooms, and rosemary mashed potatoes.

products.descriptionEs: Arroz Carnaroli cremoso cocinado con hongos porcini silvestres, mantequilla trufada, caldo de verduras y queso parmesano reggiano.
products.descriptionEn: Creamy Carnaroli rice cooked with wild porcini mushrooms, truffle butter, vegetable broth, and Parmigiano Reggiano cheese.
Lamb shank braised for 8 hours in aromatic herbs and red wine, served alongside creamy mascarpone polenta.
Handmade light ricotta gnocchi tossed in Genovese basil pesto, toasted pine nuts, and confit cherry tomatoes.

products.nameEs: Bistec Fiorentina a la Parrilla (Para Compartir)
products.descriptionEn: 32 oz dry-aged porterhouse steak, wood-fired over oak, served with rosemary roasted potatoes and baby vegetables.
Traditional Tuscan coastal seafood stew featuring prawns, calamari, clams, white fish, and a lightly spicy tomato broth.

products.nameEs: Pato Confitado con Glaseado de Higo
products.nameEn: Confit Duck Leg with Fig Glaze
products.descriptionEn: Crispy-skinned duck leg confit served over braised Beluga lentils with a rich fig and Port wine reduction.

products.nameEs: Ravioli de Langosta en Salsa Rosa
products.descriptionEn: Handmade black pasta ravioli stuffed with Maine lobster meat, swimming in a creamy tomato and brandy pink sauce.
Refreshing non-alcoholic cocktail with hibiscus flower infusion, fresh grapefruit juice, artisanal tonic water, and rosemary.
House-made artisanal limoncello mixed with sparkling Italian Prosecco, club soda, and a fresh lemon wheel.
Premium gin, sweet red vermouth, and Campari aged in American oak barrels for 30 days for an extra smooth flavor profile.
Bottle of naturally sparkling mineral water sourced from the Italian Alps, perfect for pairing with any meal.
Tuscan red wine featuring notes of ripe cherry, leather, and spices, traditionally fermented in terracotta amphorae.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con múltiples opciones de pasta sin gluten, risottos y platos vegetarianos. Pregunte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer multiple gluten-free pasta options, risottos, and vegetarian dishes. Please ask your server.

faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y reservaciones telefónicas o en línea para grupos de cualquier tamaño.
faqs.aEn: We welcome both walk-ins and phone/online reservations for parties of all sizes.

faqs.qEn: Are pets allowed on the patio?
faqs.aEs: Sí, nuestra terraza exterior admite perros durante la temporada cálida.
faqs.aEn: Yes, our outdoor patio is dog-friendly during the warm season.
